channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: German soccer team cancels Minnesota visit due to ICE crackdown
item.description: Bundesliga side Werder Bremen were planning to visit in May, though no matches were scheduled.

item.title: Hundreds march in south Minneapolis to honor Alex Pretti
item.description: Saturday gathering came nearly a month after nurse was fatally shot by federal agents

item.title: How it unfolded: Recap the girls hockey state championships
item.description: Hill-Murray beat Centennial/Spring Lake Park 4-3 in the 2A final. Breck defeated Warroad 4-1 in the 1A final.

item.title: Review: Brandi Carlile wraps herself around Minneapolis with a special guest
item.description: She showed solidarity with the Twin Cities during an Olympian performance.

item.title: Live: Jessie Diggins’ last Olympic race, U.S.-Canada men’s hockey highlight Sunday’s slate
item.description: Diggins competes in the women’s 50-kilometer at 3 a.m., while Team USA plays Canada for gold at 7:10 a.m. on NBC.

item.title: You’ll never guess what’s making those weird blue spots in the snow
item.description: It’s a surprising downstream effect from one of Minnesota’s biggest invasive plant problems.

item.title: Inside the fight over corporate activism and the Minnesota CEO letter
item.description: Tension over how companies have responded to a surge in immigration enforcement is the climax of a yearslong reckoning with a local tradition of corporate social responsibility.

item.title: Vikings wide receiver Rondale Moore dead at 25
item.description: Moore, who spent the past year on the Vikings roster, died of a suspected self-inflicted gunshot.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.

item.title: Minnesota bars opening extra early Sunday for Team USA’s gold medal hockey game
item.description: The U.S. men’s hockey team will face Canada with a gold medal on the line at 7:10 a.m. Sunday.
